findings.issue: `localOrientationOfZeroDim_eq_iff` splits into four sign cases. Each case repeats `rw` with the 80-plus-character lemma names `..._eq_localOrientationOfZeroDimChart_of_orientationAt_eq` and `..._eq_neg_..._of_orientationAt_eq_neg`, then closes with a hand-built iff. `localOrientationOfZeroDim_neg` uses the same chain style. A rename of either helper breaks every branch.

summary: The earlier undocumented `change` steps and repeated rank-zero derivations are fixed, and the remaining defeq workarounds have comments. One morphism-to-element conversion is still written out by hand three times, and `localOrientationOfZeroDim_eq_iff` is a four-case chain of rewrites with long lemma names where `simp` would do.
